scripts.db:clean: pnpm db:up && docker rm -f parker_supertokens && ../../tools/scripts/drop_db.sh supertokens parker_postgres_dev && ../../tools/scripts/drop_user.sh supertokens parker_postgres_dev
scripts.db:restore-fixtures: pnpm db:clean && pnpm db:up && ../../tools/scripts/restore_fixtures.sh supertokens postgres://supertokens:supertokens_password@localhost:5432/supertokens?sslmode=disable && pnpm db:migrate-up
scripts.serve: docker rm -f parker_supertokens && docker run --name parker_supertokens --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e POSTGRESQL_USER="supertokens" -e POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD="supertokens_password" -e POSTGRESQL_HOST="host.docker.internal" -e POSTGRESQL_PORT="6440" -e LOG_LEVEL="${LOG_LEVEL:-WARN}" -p 4567:3567 --rm registry.supertokens.io/supertokens/supertokens-postgresql:11.4.5
